facts: Parties: Calloway Retail Group plc (Buyer), Marlow Bioscience plc (Seller); the Company is Corrib Foods Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 11 March 2026; Closing is scheduled for 22 June 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 8.2 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 15% of the Purchase Price, being $21,600,000. The Purchase Price is $160,000,000 (see Section 2.1).
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 5 years after Closing.
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 2 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $6,500,000, capped at $5,000,000.

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 24 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 48 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $5,000,000.
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 18 months after termination of employment.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $7,300,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $1,200,000.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $4,090,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $158,180,000.
